title: I’m building BeeOnFlow, an endless arcade game about a bee pollinating flowers. Looking for feedback on the prototype, it's my first AI game.
author: WovenFalcon
selftext:
Hi! I’ve been working on **BeeOnFlow**, a small arcade prototype about a bee flying through changing gardens, following pollen trails, dodging hazards, and pollinating each flower to move on.

Each garden has its own look and obstacles, and the run is endless. I used AI tools extensively while building the prototype, and I’m now looking for honest feedback.

**Prototype:** [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fZmOu0-Bnb31uLJ\_XQF-2P-HxEjNKNji/view?usp=drive\_link](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fZmOu0-Bnb31uLJ_XQF-2P-HxEjNKNji/view?usp=drive_link)

I’d especially appreciate feedback on the controls, difficulty, and whether the different gardens feel distinct. What would make you want to play another run?
